name: turndown-cli
description: A CLI for the turndown HTML to Markdown converter.

scripts.build:macos: bun run prebuild && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/turndown-cli-macos-arm64 && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/turndown-cli-macos-x64
scripts.build:linux: bun run prebuild && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target bun-linux-arm64 --outfile dist/turndown-cli-linux-arm64 && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/turndown-cli-linux-x64

author: Mathew Gacy
